vulnerability_analysis: The contract has owner-only functions that allow privilege abuse. The owner can set the marketing wallet to any address, and when swapAndLiquify is triggered, ETH marketing fees are sent to that wallet. By setting marketing wallet to attacker address and triggering the swap mechanism, the attacker can steal ETH from the contract.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, set marketing wallet to attacker address, accumulate tokens in contract, then trigger swapAndLiquify to receive ETH marketing fees.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank
2. Call setMarketingWallet(attacker) to redirect fees
3. Ensure swapAndLiquifyEnabled is true (default)
4. Transfer tokens to contract to accumulate balance above threshold
5. Make a transfer (not from pair) to trigger swapAndLiquify
6. Attacker receives ETH marketing fees
